title: Koi charagh jalao
body:
koi charagh jalao bahot andhera hai
sakina ko na jagao bahot andhera hai
<<DIVIDER>>
sar e hussain dikha kar yateem bachi ko
sitamgaron na rulaao bahot andhera hai
koi charagh jalao...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye rote rote huwe sogayi hai jaag na jaye
thapak thapak ke sulaao bahot andhera hai
koi charagh jalao...
<<DIVIDER>>
kab aayi raat ye din kab dhala nahi maloom
phupi charagh jalao bahot andhera hai
koi charagh jalao...
<<DIVIDER>>
sakina bibi ka zindan mein jee hai ghabrata
khudara rehm to khao bahot andhera hai
koi charagh jalao...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaha sakina ne ro kar meri phupi amma
mujhe na chod ke jao bahot andhera hai
koi charagh jalao...
<<DIVIDER>>
andhera zindan andheri qabr hai ay mirza
charagh dil ke jalao bahot andhera hai
koi charagh jalao...
author: Mirza Murtaza Ali
